name: Singed Scale
summary: In Durotar, Singed Scale comes from the charred plates of electrified thunder lizards. Horde warriors bring the scales to prove their endurance and learn defensive combat.

sections.title: A Test of Endurance
sections.body: Horde veterans judge a warrior by the blows they can bear while shielding allies. In Thunder Ridge, a canyon in western Durotar, lightning hides and thunder lizards crackle with storm energy. Hunting these beasts means enduring relentless electrical shocks and crushing blows. Their blackened scales show that a fighter can withstand punishing assaults and hold firm under pressure.

sections.title: The Way of the Shield
sections.body: At the Far Watch Post, on the border between Durotar and the Barrens, the veteran warrior Uzzek asks initiates for five scales before teaching them. He believes they need physical toughness before they can learn stances and tactical defense. Bringing the scales proves they have the fortitude to join thick hide, heavy armor, and careful footwork into a firm defense against the Horde’s enemies.

faq.q: What are singed scales used for?
faq.answer: Singed scales prove martial endurance. Uzzek, a warrior trainer, requires five before teaching an initiate advanced defensive techniques.

faq.q: Where do you find singed scales?
faq.answer: You find singed scales on thunder lizards and lightning hides in Thunder Ridge, a canyon in western Durotar across the river from the Barrens.

Thunder lizards channel lightning and electrical storms through their bodies. The persistent crackle of elemental energy scorches and blackens their outer hide, giving the scales their charred texture.

faq.q: Who is Uzzek and why does he care about these scales?
faq.answer: Uzzek is a veteran warrior at the Far Watch Post in the eastern Barrens. He trains rising Horde warriors in defensive combat and requires them to prove their resilience against deadly beasts first.

angles.text: As a developing warrior, bringing the scales to Uzzek marks a core milestone in learning protection and standing as an impenetrable shield for the Horde.
At the Far Watch Post, trials ensure that guards and vanguards on the Durotar and Barrens frontiers possess unyielding stamina.
